name: @pipeworx/mcp-ats-boards

tools.name: ats_detect
tools.description: Detect which applicant-tracking system (ATS) a company publishes its public job board on, and its board token. Reads the company's careers page (or a given careers_url) for a Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters/Recruitee/BambooHR/Workday/Workable/Teamtailor/Personio/Jobvite/Breezy/Pinpoint/Rippling/iCIMS link; falls back to slug-probing the domain name against each board API that supports it. Does not read any private/Harvest-key ATS data — only what a public job board already exposes. Discoveries persist so repeat lookups for the same domain are instant.

domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "airbnb.com" (no scheme, no path).

careers_url.description: A specific careers-page URL to scan instead of guessing one from domain, e.g. "https://www.airbnb.com/careers".

tools.name: ats_jobs
tools.description: Fetch normalized job postings from a PUBLIC ATS board you already have the ats + board_token for (use ats_detect or ats_company_jobs if you only have a domain). Returns {found:false, reason:"board_not_found"} for an unknown board — never an empty jobs[] for that case. Lever/Ashby/BambooHR/Recruitee/Teamtailor/Breezy DO distinguish a real zero-job board (found:true, jobs:[]) from an unknown one; SmartRecruiters cannot (ambiguous:true); Pinpoint and iCIMS have not had a confirmed-empty real board observed live, so a 0-job result from those two is NOT independently confirmed to mean "real board, no jobs" versus a mis-detected token. Workday board_token is "<tenant>.wd<N>/<site>" (e.g. "workday.wd5/Workday"); its response states capped:true if your limit/offset hit Workday's own pagination limits (limit<=20, offset<=10000). Workable is currently blocked by Cloudflare from this platform's edge and will throw a loud error naming the 429, not an empty result. Dover is NOT supported: its public board is a Cloudflare-Turnstile-gated SPA with no keyless jobs endpoint.

board_token.description: The board identifier: Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/SmartRecruiters/Teamtailor/Personio/Breezy/Pinpoint company slug or subdomain label; Recruitee/BambooHR subdomain label; Jobvite slug (path segment after jobs.jobvite.com/); Rippling slug (path segment after ats.rippling.com/); iCIMS full subdomain label before .icims.com (e.g. "careers-acme" — prefixes vary by customer); Workable account slug; Workday "<tenant>.wd<N>/<site>".

filters.description: Optional post-fetch filters and Workday pagination controls.

title_query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on job title. For Workday this is also sent upstream as the search text.

remote_only.description: Keep only jobs flagged remote (where the ATS reports it).

region.description: Lever only: "eu" queries api.eu.lever.co instead of api.lever.co.

limit.description: Workday only: page size, clamped to 20 (Workday itself rejects anything higher with HTTP 400).

offset.description: Workday only: pagination offset, clamped to 10000 (Workday's own cap).

tools.name: ats_company_jobs
tools.description: Detect a company's public ATS board from its domain, then fetch its postings in one call — ats_detect + ats_jobs combined. Returns the same {found:false, reason:"no_ats_detected"} shape as ats_detect when no board can be found.

tools.name: ats_new_postings
tools.description: Diff a board's current postings against the last time this tool was called for the same ats+board_token (snapshot kept in KV, dated). The FIRST call for a board has no prior snapshot, so it returns every current job as new (snapshot_bootstrap:true) rather than a misleading empty diff. Pass "since" (ISO date) to also require posted_at >= since where the ATS reports a date.

ats.description: Which ATS the board is on.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 date/time; only postings with posted_at on or after this (where the ATS reports a date) count as new.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ats-boards forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ats-boards pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
